reason: My broker already buys the same index funds for me every payday for free, and I barely open it. I don't need a pet agent rebalancing and paying for things, and paying a monthly fee for something I already get free makes no sense.
objection: A Tamagotchi feels unserious for my actual savings, and right now it's demo money with no broker or price named, so I'd be signing up for a fee on a promise.
would_change_my_mind: If it ran inside a licensed broker I already trust, let me turn the pet off, and cost a couple of dollars a month while clearly beating what my free recurring buy does.
